import numpy as np,itertools
r=np.arange(10)[:,None]; c=np.arange(10)[None,:]
ops={'R':r<5,'B':c<=r,'T':c<=9-r,'S':c<=np.minimum(r,4)}
target=np.array([[ch=='f' for ch in s] for s in ['ffffffffff','0fffffffff','00ffffffff','000fffffff','0000ffffff','0000ffffff','000fffffff','00ffffffff','0fffffffff','ffffffffff']])
sol=[]
for n in range(1,8):
 for seq in itertools.product([(k,v) for k in ops for v in [0,1]],repeat=n):
  a=np.zeros((10,10),bool)
  for (k,v) in seq:a[ops[k]]=v
  if np.array_equal(a,target):sol.append(seq);break
 if sol:break
print(sol[:1])
